recipe.visualDefinition: A four-quadrant photographic collage featuring character portraits bathed in a warm, high-contrast orange and red glow, anchored by a large, central geometric numeral and a clean bottom text bar.
coreVisualRelationships: Four-way symmetrical split for character portraits
Central overlapping graphic element as a focal point
Monochromatic warm color wash across all photographic elements
High-contrast white typography against saturated backgrounds
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and soft-focus backgrounds
Solid red footer bar for secondary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four portraits occupying equal quadrants; central graphic scaled to overlap all four sections.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: Large white geometric numeral at the center intersection.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Clockwise from top-left portrait to top-right, down to bottom-right, then bottom-left, ending at the central graphic and footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with portraits and textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Saturated orange and amber midtones in portraits.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red shadows and background textures.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for primary and secondary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with compressed value range, favoring warm highlights and dark red shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Numerals constructed from thick, uniform geometric strokes
Interlocking or overlapping paths between digits
Sharp 45-degree angles and perfect circular curves
Negative space cutouts within the glyphs to show underlying imagery
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numeral '5' features a circular lower bowl and a horizontal top bar that integrates with the adjacent digit
Numeral '4' uses an open-top or interlocking diagonal structure
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large geometric custom numerals paired with a clean, widely-spaced sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Lens flare or light glint on central graphic

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric roots of the 1970s aesthetic.
Captures the specific disco-era geometric flair.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 2x2 grid collage of four distinct character portraits. Apply a heavy orange and red duotone filter. Add film grain and soft-focus background textures suggesting a crowded nightclub. Include a solid red horizontal bar at the very bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, custom-drawn geometric white numerals in the center where the quadrants meet. Add a single line of all-caps, widely-spaced white sans-serif text centered within the bottom red bar.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm (orange/red/white)?
Is the central graphic interlocking or overlapping?
Is the footer text all-caps and widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the orange/red color wash
Specific geometric style of the central numerals
Width of the bottom footer bar

mustAchieve: Cohesive warm color grading across all images

postGenerationChecks: Check for color consistency across all four quadrants.
Ensure the central graphic is perfectly centered.
Verify the footer text is legible against the red background.
Confirm the absence of any blue or green tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: 4-Quadrant Portrait Grid + Warm Duotone Filter + Central Geometric Graphic + Wide-Tracked Footer Text
